-- class: contract
-- name: audit-ddl

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-schema
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create schema if not exists "audit";

-- class: expand
-- kind: alter-owner
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter schema "audit" owner to "okm_role:migration";

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "audit"."ddl_command" (
  "cascade" boolean not null,
  "command_tag" text not null,
  "id" bigint generated always as identity not null,
  "object_identity" text not null,
  "object_type" text not null,
  "schema_name" text,
  "txid" text not null,
  constraint "ddl_command_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: alter-owner
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "audit"."ddl_command" owner to "okm_role:migration";

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-schema
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create schema if not exists "audit";

-- class: expand
-- kind: alter-owner
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter schema "audit" owner to "okm_role:migration";

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "audit"."ddl_tx" (
  "actor" text not null,
  "app_name" text not null,
  "app_user" text,
  "at" timestamptz not null,
  "client_addr" inet,
  "query_text" text not null,
  "txid" text not null,
  constraint "ddl_tx_pkey" primary key ("txid")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: alter-owner
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "audit"."ddl_tx" owner to "okm_role:migration";

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "public"."notes" (
  "id" bigint generated always as identity not null,
  constraint "notes_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-schema
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create schema if not exists "audit";

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-function
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create function "audit"."okm_audit_ddl"() returns event_trigger language plpgsql volatile security definer set search_path to audit, pg_temp as $okm$declare cmd record; obj record;
begin
  insert into "audit"."ddl_tx" ("txid", "at", "actor", "app_name", "client_addr", "query_text", "app_user")
  values (txid_current()::text, now(), session_user, current_setting('application_name', true), inet_client_addr(), current_query(), nullif(current_setting('okm.application_user', true), ''))
  on conflict ("txid") do nothing;
  if tg_event = 'sql_drop' then
    for obj in select * from pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects() loop
      if obj.is_temporary then continue; end if;
      insert into "audit"."ddl_command" ("txid", "command_tag", "object_type", "object_identity", "schema_name", "cascade")
      values (txid_current()::text, tg_tag, obj.object_type, obj.object_identity, obj.schema_name, not obj.original);
    end loop;
    return;
  end if;
  for cmd in select * from pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() loop
    if cmd.in_extension then continue; end if;
    if cmd.schema_name like 'pg_temp%' then continue; end if;
    insert into "audit"."ddl_command" ("txid", "command_tag", "object_type", "object_identity", "schema_name", "cascade")
    values (txid_current()::text, cmd.command_tag, cmd.object_type, cmd.object_identity, cmd.schema_name, false);
  end loop;
end$okm$;

-- class: contract
-- kind: revoke
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
revoke execute on function "audit"."okm_audit_ddl"() from public;

-- class: expand
-- kind: alter-owner
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter function "audit"."okm_audit_ddl"() owner to "okm_role:migration";

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-event-trigger
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create event trigger "okm_audit_drop" on sql_drop execute function "audit"."okm_audit_ddl"();

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-event-trigger
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create event trigger "okm_audit_end" on ddl_command_end execute function "audit"."okm_audit_ddl"();

create table "audit"."ddl_command" (
  "cascade" boolean not null,

  "txid" text not null,
  constraint "ddl_command_pkey" primary key ("id")
)

create table "audit"."ddl_tx" (
  "actor" text not null,
  "app_name" text not null,
  "app_user" text,
  "at" timestamptz not null,
  "client_addr" inet,
  "query_text" text not null,
  "txid" text not null,
  constraint "ddl_tx_pkey" primary key ("txid")
)

create table "public"."notes" (
  "id" bigint generated always as identity not null,
  constraint "notes_pkey" primary key ("id")
)
revoke execute on function "audit"."okm_audit_ddl"() from public
create event trigger "okm_audit_drop" on sql_drop execute function "audit"."okm_audit_ddl"()
create event trigger "okm_audit_end" on ddl_command_end execute function "audit"."okm_audit_ddl"()
